title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule C: Onboarding Fees and Seat Administration
content:
For each ClearPath Managed IT Services tier this schedule sets the one-time onboarding fee per seat and its minimum, the initial term that waives it, the onboarding planning target, and the seat administration timings: the lead time for a new user, the same-day offboarding cutoff and the monthly true-up day.

## C.1 Onboarding fee and target

| Tier | Onboarding fee per contracted seat (USD) | Minimum onboarding fee (USD) | Initial term that waives the fee | Onboarding target |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 25.00 | 495.00 | 36 months or more | 10 business days |
| ClearPath Essentials | 45.00 | 1250.00 | 36 months or more | 20 business days |
| ClearPath Standard | 60.00 | 1750.00 | 36 months or more | 25 business days |
| ClearPath Professional | 75.00 | 2500.00 | 36 months or more | 30 business days |
| ClearPath Premier | 95.00 | 3750.00 | 36 months or more | 35 business days |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 120.00 | 9500.00 | 36 months or more | 60 business days |

The onboarding fee is a one-time fee per contracted seat, and the minimum applies regardless of seat count. The waiver figure is the initial term length at or above which the onboarding fee is waived. The onboarding target is counted in business days from onboarding kickoff to go-live.

## C.2 Seat administration timings

| Tier | New-user lead time | Same-day offboarding cutoff (US Eastern) | True-up snapshot day |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 5 business days | 15:00 | 25th of the month |
| ClearPath Essentials | 3 business days | 15:00 | 25th of the month |
| ClearPath Standard | 3 business days | 16:00 | 25th of the month |
| ClearPath Professional | 2 business days | 16:00 | 25th of the month |
| ClearPath Premier | 2 business days | 17:00 | 25th of the month |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 1 business day | 17:00 | 25th of the month |

- **New-user lead time**: the business days of advance notice required for a new-user onboarding to be ready on the requested start date.
- **Same-day offboarding cutoff**: the time of day, US Eastern, before which an offboarding request received on a business day is completed the same day.
- **True-up snapshot day**: the day of each calendar month on which licensed directory users are reconciled against the covered seats.

## C.3 Hypothetical illustration

On a hypothetical 30-seat ClearPath Standard agreement signed for 24 months, 30 times 60.00 gives 1800.00, above the 1750.00 minimum, so the fee is 1800.00. At 20 seats the product would be 1200.00 and the minimum of 1750.00 applies. Signed for 36 months, either agreement has its fee waived.
